subject: Ciências da Natureza e suas Tecnologias
description_pt: Analisar e discutir modelos, teorias e leis propostos em diferentes épocas e culturas para comparar distintas explicações sobre o surgimento e a evolução da Vida, da Terra e do Universo com as teorias científicas aceitas atualmente.

components.description_pt: Descrever modelos, teorias e leis de diferentes épocas e culturas sobre a origem da Vida, Terra e Universo
components.description_en: Describe models, theories, and laws from different eras and cultures about the origin of Life, Earth, and the Universe
components.cc_component_description: Analyze the composition of matter in the universe as evidence consistent with Big Bang nucleosynthesis

components.description_pt: Comparar explicações históricas e culturais sobre a origem da Vida, Terra e Universo com teorias científicas atuais
components.description_en: Compare historical and cultural explanations for the origin of Life, Earth, and the Universe with current scientific theories

components.description_pt: Analisar como teorias científicas sobre a evolução da Vida, Terra e Universo mudaram ao longo do tempo
components.description_en: Analyze how scientific theories about the evolution of Life, Earth, and the Universe have changed over time
components.cc_component_description: Analyze the fossil record to support claims about the diversity and evolution of life forms on Earth

components.description_pt: Avaliar argumentos científicos concorrentes ou soluções de design contra explicações aceitas e novas evidências
components.description_en: Evaluate competing scientific arguments or design solutions against currently accepted explanations and new evidence
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate competing scientific arguments or design solutions against currently accepted explanations and new evidence

cc_matches.description: Compare and evaluate competing arguments or design solutions in light of currently accepted explanations, new evidence, limitations (e.g., trade-offs), constraints, and ethical issues.
Construct an explanation of the Big Bang theory based on astronomical evidence of light spectra, motion of distant galaxies, and composition of matter in the universe.

The collection of fossils and their placement in chronological order (e.g., through the location of the sedimentary layers in which they are found or through radioactive dating) is known as the fossil record. It documents the existence, diversity, extinction, and change of many life forms throughout the history of life on Earth.
